question:
Let $A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 0\\-1 & 3 & 2\\2 & 1 & 1\end{bmatrix}$.

(a) Determine all the minors of the second row.

(b) Find the corresponding cofactors of the second row.

(c) Hence, evaluate $|A|$ by expanding along the second row and verify it by expansion along the first row.
explanation:
(a)
The minors of the elements in the second row are
$$M_{21}=\begin{vmatrix}2 & 0\\1 & 1\end{vmatrix}=2$$
$$M_{22}=\begin{vmatrix}1 & 0\\2 & 1\end{vmatrix}=1$$
$$M_{23}=\begin{vmatrix}1 & 2\\2 & 1\end{vmatrix}=1-4=-3$$

(b)
Using $A_{ij}=(-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}$,
$$A_{21}=-M_{21}=-2$$
$$A_{22}=M_{22}=1$$
$$A_{23}=-M_{23}=3$$

(c)
Expanding along the second row,
$$|A|=(-1)(-2)+3(1)+2(3)=2+3+6=11$$
For verification, expansion along the first row gives
$$|A|=1\begin{vmatrix}3 & 2\\1 & 1\end{vmatrix}-2\begin{vmatrix}-1 & 2\\2 & 1\end{vmatrix}$$
$$|A|=(3-2)-2(-1-4)=1+10=11$$
Hence, $|A|=11$ is verified.

options.C:
(a) $M_{21}=2,\ M_{22}=1,\ M_{23}=-3$
(b) $A_{21}=-2,\ A_{22}=1,\ A_{23}=3$
(c) $|A|=11$, which is also obtained by expansion along the first row
